Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: CMM-601.6: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level
Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft
Required findings: Post‑operative imaging (plain radiographs, CT or MRI) demonstrates malposition, migration, breakage, loosening, loss of curve correction, decompensation, or other implant failure at the previously fused level
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.6 > Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Required findings: >6 months elapsed since prior ACDF at the same level
Significant daily neck pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)
Physical examination findings concordant with patient’s pain (e.g., localized tenderness, limited range of motion)

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement with BOTH prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids AND a provider‑directed exercise program for ≥6 weeks (unless contraindicated)
Post‑operative imaging performed ≥6 months after the index fusion shows radiographic evidence of pseudoarthrosis at the operative level
Post‑operative MRI or CT demonstrates neural structure compression at the same level that correlates with symptoms
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Documented nicotine‑free status (never‑smoker or ≥6 weeks abstinence verified by serum, urine or saliva cotinine test)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.6 > Unremitting Neck Pain with Pseudoarthrosis

Required findings: >6 months elapsed since prior ACDF at the same level
Significant daily neck pain with disabling radicular pain to the shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity

Physical exam shows any of: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor weakness (biceps/triceps), reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, positive Spurling’s maneuver, or radicular pain without objective findings

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of: prescription‑strength analgesics/NSAIDs/gabapentinoids/steroids, a provider‑directed exercise program for ≥6 weeks, epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block at the operative level (unless contraindicated)
Post‑operative imaging ≥6 months after prior fusion shows pseudoarthrosis at the operative level
MRI/CT shows neural compression at the same level caused by herniated disc, synovial/arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis or osteophytes and correlates with symptoms
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Documented nicotine‑free status (never‑smoker or ≥6 weeks abstinence verified by objective cotinine testing)

Important criteria & exceptions: Patient must be nicotine-free prior to planned surgery verified by objective testing.
Absence of unmanaged significant behavioral or mental health disorders.
Non-Indications: Procedures performed before the required post-operative duration has elapsed (e.g., < 6 months from prior surgery).
Neck pain or radiculopathy without objective physical exam findings or concordant advanced imaging (MRI/CT).
Failure to complete the mandatory trial of conservative therapy (minimum 6 weeks of PT/medications) unless contraindicated.
Active tobacco or nicotine use without verified 6-week cessation and negative cotinine laboratory test.
Presence of unmanaged significant behavioral or mental health disorders, active opioid/alcohol use disorder, or secondary gain.
Documentation required: Operative reports from prior cervical decompression or fusion surgery (confirming levels and surgical date).
Plain cervical spine X-rays with flexion and extension lateral views showing fusion and stability.
Advanced imaging reports (MRI or CT of cervical spine) documenting neural structure compression or stenosis concordant with symptoms.
Detailed physical examination records documenting functional impairment and objective neurological deficits.
Physical therapy records and pharmacy prescription logs documenting >= 6 weeks of continuous conservative therapy.
Objective cotinine laboratory test results (serum, urine, or saliva) confirming nicotine-free status (or signed never-smoker attestation).
Behavioral/mental health evaluation notes confirming absence of unmanaged psychiatric or substance use disorders.
